items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: Well you know Gary Grant is not playing anymore so you know he was like a key member of the horn section.

ctx.x: Did the Jerry Hey Horns individuals get their parts beforehand?

Only on a couple occasions did I send Gary Grant like any kind of real technical thing that I had written, just one or two bars, kind of the speed demon lick in Michael Jackson if you know that [scats] that crazy one. So I sent him that one just so we’d go in — saxophones, they can play anything you know. But you know that intense of a trumpet lick, so because I wrote it, I know it and I can play it. And if Gary’s got a little head start on something then you know it’s fewer takes for us to try to get it together…
Did you ever write something that you couldn’t play? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
